files.name: POLICY-IN
files.text: SELECT POLICY-IN ASSIGN TO POLIN ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-PI-ST.

files.name: PROPERTY-IN
files.text: SELECT PROPERTY-IN ASSIGN TO PROPIN ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-PR-ST.

files.name: VEHICLE-IN
files.text: SELECT VEHICLE-IN ASSIGN TO VEHIN ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-VE-ST.

files.name: COVERAGE-IN
files.text: SELECT COVERAGE-IN ASSIGN TO COVGIN ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-CO-ST.

files.name: PREMIUM-OUT
files.text: SELECT PREMIUM-OUT ASSIGN TO PREMOUT ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-PO-ST.

files.name: ERROR-OUT
files.text: SELECT ERROR-OUT ASSIGN TO ERROUT ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-ER-ST.

move.text: MOVE 'NO COVERAGE RECORDS FOR POLICY' TO ER-MESSAGE
MOVE 'AUTO VEHICLE RECORD NOT FOUND' TO ER-MESSAGE
MOVE 'PRODUCT TYPE MUST BE HO OR AU' TO ER-MESSAGE
MOVE 'PREMIUM OUTPUT WRITE FAILED' TO ER-MESSAGE

open.text: OPEN INPUT POLICY-IN PROPERTY-IN VEHICLE-IN COVERAGE-IN OUTPUT PREMIUM-OUT ERROR-OUT

close.text: CLOSE POLICY-IN PROPERTY-IN VEHICLE-IN COVERAGE-IN PREMIUM-OUT ERROR-OUT.

if.text: IF NOT POL-EOF AND NOT FATAL-ERROR
IF FATAL-ERROR MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE END-IF
